biggest_catch: TRIBE's official rule is 'you set your price' — which means there is no platform pay rate, range, or minimum at all. Every dollar depends on a brand approving your pitch, and their own guide warns 'you get out what you put in.'
catches: TRIBE's official influencer handbook: 'Because TRIBE is a digital marketplace, you're free to set your own price!' — creator-set pricing means zero guaranteed or typical figure from the platform.
Every campaign requires your pitch to be approved by the brand; pre-approval locks in 50% of your fee upfront, but nothing is earned until a brand picks you.
3,000+ followers required to join as a creator (per TRIBE's own app listing).
Video submissions earn 25-50% more than photos per TRIBE's own tips — but 'more' than a number you set yourself is not a pay figure.
Campaign pricing for brands includes a 30% margin on creator spend (per third-party analysis) — brand-side cost, not creator pay.

c1.evidence: No concrete pay figure (no per-post rate, range, or minimum) on any official TRIBE page — official policy is creator-set pricing ('you set your price'), which is the opposite of a stated payout.

c2.evidence: tribegroup.co is the official domain (influencer marketing platform); official pages describe the marketplace without any pay figures.

c3.evidence: No upfront creator fee stated on official pages.

c4.evidence: Official handbook: pre-approved creators lock in 50% of their fee upfront; paid on publish — timing mechanics exist but with no pay figure attached.

eligibility: 3,000+ followers required (per TRIBE's own app listing). Instagram/TikTok/Facebook creators. Must pitch and be approved per campaign.
notes: REJECT is a verifiability verdict, not a scam flag: TRIBE is a real marketplace ($34M+ paid out to creators per its site, 13,500+ campaigns), but the strict checklist requires a concrete payout in official terms and TRIBE's own model is 'you set your price' — no platform figure exists to verify. The catalog's $300 claim is unsupported. Do not list this route as verified. Re-check if TRIBE publishes rate guidance.
